agent_security.plan_kts:
fun plan() {
  val registry = read_repo_file("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/plan-tools.md")
  val scope = read_repo_file("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/scope.json")
  val changedFiles = read_repo_file("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/changed-files.txt")
  val diff = read_repo_file("/tmp/gh-aw/agent/pr.diff")
  val taskContext = read_repo_file("/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
  val engineeringPrinciples = read_repo_file(".repo_context/modules/overview/engineering-principles.md")
  val testsReproduction = read_repo_file(".repo_context/modules/quality/tests-and-reproduction.md")
  val testPaths = run_command(listOf("rg", "--files", "tests", "cli"))
  val changedSource = read_repo_file("cli/net_check.py")
  val selfVerification = read_repo_file(".repo_context/playbooks/upkeep/ai-self-verification.md")
  val repoState = run_command(listOf("git", "status", "--short"))
  val cliLayout = run_command(listOf("find", "cli", "-maxdepth", "2", "-type", "f"))
  val pythonTests = run_command(listOf("find", "tests/python", "-maxdepth", "2", "-type", "f"))
  val verdict = compute(scope, changedFiles, diff, taskContext, engineeringPrinciples, testsReproduction, testPaths, changedSource, selfVerification, repoState, cliLayout, pythonTests)
  write_file("/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", verdict)
  publish("safeoutputs noop", "No action needed: evidence.json records the tests-updated-appropriately verdict for PR 215.")
}
